d:
A vampire-like humanoid species with pale alabaster skin and a long flowing cape of deep crimson fabric. The head features sharp fangs and slicked-back jet black hair. A slender build is paired with a high-collared tuxedo in midnight black and a stark white cravat. The creature has two large, leathery bat-like wings attached to the back and a short pointed tail. 5 fingers per hand.
BODY COLOR: pale alabaster
